name: Todd Rudin
headline: Managing Director
about: Over 12 years of experience developing successful digital transformation programs for enterprise companies, supported by a deep understanding of below the line marketing, marketing and finance technologies. I have worked with marketing, finance, and IT leadership teams at global companies to identify business requirements and propose digital solutions in both vendor and consultancy scenarios.

Kolleno is on a mission to help businesses streamline credit control and collections whilst maintaining positive client relationships. We automate key credit control functions and use intelligent omnichannel communication to recover outstanding payments.  
  
Our custom-built solution is designed to provide you with a 360° view of your receivables, boost your finance team’s productivity and optimise your working capital.

Quadient is the driving force behind the world’s most meaningful customer experiences. We help organizations deliver exceptional experiences by focusing on four key solutions: Mail Room Solutions, Business Process Automation, Customer Experience Management, and Parcel Locker Solutions

Quadient’s Business Process Automation (BPA) solutions help organisations optimise document processing and communications. Cut operational costs, improve the customer and employee experience, and drive business growth by automating business-critical outbound and inbound processes. Ultimately we offer Cradle to Grave solutions for everything OTC and AP.

I lead a direct sales team focusing on the B2B Retail, Wholesale, ICT, and Telecommunication sectors.

Sidetrade's leading Artificial Intelligence solution to positively impact your P&L, Free Cash Flow and Working Capital.

Over 1,000 companies, of all sizes and verticals, in 80 countries, daily use A.I Sidetrade Platform for sustainable growth. Sidetrade is recognised by both Forrester and Gartner as one of the most exciting AI solutions in the marketplace.

Crownpeak is a leading digital experience solution provider, powered by K1 Capital Investment. Everything we do is SaaS and in the cloud. At Crownpeak we do 3 things very well: 

DXM
The creation and management of content, using our Gartner and Forrester recognised DXM solution. 

DQM
Optimising your digital estate for SEO and Accessibility, while ensuring brand consistency and mitigating legal risk. 

DGM
Our Tag Auditor solution helps you de-mystify your digital estate, identify data leakage and assist with vendor management. Our Universal Consent Platform ensures regulatory compliance, for all things Privacy related; GDPR and ePrivacy included.  

Leading brands trust Crownpeak’s cloud-first solutions to enhance their customers' experiences. As a business we focus on: Financial Services, Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, Retail, Media & Entertainment; and Consumer Goods.

My role is to ensure our clients' needs are met with our solutions across EMEA.

Varnish Software is the company behind Varnish Cache, an open-source HTTP engine, trusted by more than 3 million websites worldwide. 

Varnish Plus is the enterprise version of the open-source solution and includes: Varnish High Availability, Varnish Massive Storage Engine, Varnish Enhanced Cache Invalidation, Varnish Plus Support Services, Varnish SSL/TSL Support, Varnish Mobile Device Detection, Varnish Administration Console, Varnish Paywall, Varnish Custom Statistics, Varnish Cache Plus and the Varnish Tuner

My role was working in the rapidly growing sales team based in London. Reporting to the VP of Sales & Marketing. I work with clients and users of Varnish Cache, to explain the benefits of Varnish Plus and ensure that their websites are high performance and optimised.

Celerity Information Services Limited is a Data & CRM agency; and systems integrator. Celerity is part of the Howard Hunt Group, the largest independent Marketing Services Provider in the UK. The group specialises in: data, digital marketing, multi-channel marketing, cross-media communications, print & direct mail and postal solutions.

With offices in 4 countries, employing around 400 people and revenues of £70mil+; The Howard Hunt Group is a leading SME within the marketing world.

Working very closely with the Strategic Solutions Director to identify business requirements and translate those to relevant marketing solutions. Starting and nurturing relationships with board level marketers and digital transformation professionals. 

We work in an iterative manner to assist companies with business cases for digital change right through to presentation and decision stages.

As well as my usual duties as being a Business Development Manager, I was also tasked with managing a small team of New Business Executives. The new unit was devised to increase the amount of meetings booked for the Business Development Managers and improve the lead nurturing process within Celerity.
